title: CoinRun dynamics reference-recipe repair
question: Does a reference-like long-record, long-sequence and 200k-update training bundle repair the unusable CR-DYN-0009 medium model and make its future predictions measurably depend on aligned actions?
reason: CR-DYN-0009 selected a 3.93M medium model at only 17.073 dB and direct review rejected both temporal coherence and action response. Its 64-frame records were exactly the same length as its 64-frame training window, making the configured reward-biased slicing mathematically inert. It also used 20k updates and k_max=8, far below the repository's general dynamics reference schedule.
hypothesis: Fresh 160-frame PPO records, a 64/128-frame sequence mixture, k_max=256 and 200,000 updates will improve fixed-future held-out quality and produce a positive aligned-action advantage over shuffled and no-op future actions.
falsification: Reject the repair if EMA shortcut mean-frame PSNR is below 22 dB, horizon-16 PSNR is below 20 dB, aligned future actions beat batch-shuffled actions by less than 0.25 dB at horizon 16, aligned actions beat all-noop by less than 0.50 dB, or direct visual review remains unusable.

controlled_variable.name: reference_recipe_repair_bundle
values: CR-DYN-0009 final_only-medium: 64-frame records, T=64 only, k_max=8, 20k updates
CR-DYN-0010 medium repair: 160-frame records, T=64/128, k_max=256, 200k updates

constants.policy_checkpoint: PPO official-parity final checkpoint at 25,165,824 transitions

source.source_freeze: The implementation commit will be filled after tests pass and before any remote collection or training starts. The remote worktree must be detached and clean, and the runner digest must match.

compute.estimated_budget: Approximately 8-12 A10-hours including fresh collection, baseline controls, 200k updates and terminal evaluation.
compute.shutdown_policy: Reuse only the existing A10. Stop the rejected demo only after the new detached worktree passes all preflight checks; set a 14-hour timer at launch and preserve every prior artifact.

success_criteria.rule: Fresh train and held-out records must each be episode-safe, share the exact frozen PPO checkpoint, remain level-disjoint and contain exactly 160 frames.
The training arm must start from scratch and complete exactly 200,000 updates with 64/128-frame windows, k_max=256 and the frozen medium architecture.
EMA shortcut mean-frame PSNR must be at least 22 dB and horizon-16 PSNR at least 20 dB on 128 fixed held-out futures.
At horizon 16, aligned actions must beat batch-shuffled future actions by at least 0.25 dB and all-noop future actions by at least 0.50 dB under identical context, target and noise.
A technically passing run remains awaiting visual review; metrics alone cannot establish interactive usability.
